item.title: Yemen says govt. forces repel Houthi push on key Taiz-Aden route
item.description: The steep, winding mountain pass, known as Hejat al-Abd, is a lifeline for forces fighting on behalf of Yemen’s government, which has been ‌hemmed in by a lightning Houthi advance this month linked to the Iran war Yemen says govt. forces repel Houthi push on key Taiz-Aden route.

item.title: Sri Lanka's Parliament begins debate on controversial bill on judges' retirement age
item.description: It seeks to raise the retirement age of Supreme Court judges from 65 to 67 years, while proposing to increase the number of judges in the appellate court from 20 to 25; the main opposition Samagi Jana Balawegaya (SJB) staged a protest near Parliament Sri Lanka's Parliament begins debate on controversial bill on judges' retirement age.

item.title: CNN, MS NOW, Politico allowed back in White House after judge's order
item.description: The three US media outlets sought an urgent court hearing after their reporters were initially denied entry to the White House despite a judge’s order to restore their access, before being allowed back in later on Thursday. CNN, MS NOW, Politico allowed back in White House after judge's order.

item.description: RFE/RL takes apart a Russian Geran-4 drone to uncover what makes the jet-powered unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) faster, harder to intercept, and capable of operating deep inside Ukraine -- from its turbojet engine and advanced camera to foreign-made communications and navigation components. item.title: Palestinian existence under threat, Abbas tells UN, warning of ‘another Nakba’
item.description: Israeli policies now threaten “the very life and existence of the Palestinian people on their homeland”, Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas told the UN General Assembly on Thursday, urging the world not to allow “another Nakba”. Palestinian existence under threat, Abbas tells UN, warning of ‘another Nakba’.

item.title: World leaders approve new declaration to tackle rising sea levels
item.description: Sea level rise is among the most visible consequences of global warming, but for some countries, it is an imminent existential threat. World leaders meet Thursday to adopt a new declaration and debate the best ways to strengthen international cooperation and support vulnerable low-lying nations most at risk. World leaders tackle sea level rise, a stark marker of climate change.

item.title: UN General Assembly debate Day 2
item.description: This edition of UN News's The Takeaway recaps key highlghts at the UN General Assembly on Wednesday, including focus on the war in Ukraine and a renewed push by African countries for Security Council reform. UN General Assembly debate Day 2.

item.title: US Pushes To Turn Armenia-Azerbaijan Transit Deal Into Investment Opportunity
item.description: The Trump administration is trying to turn a US-brokered opening between Armenia and Azerbaijan into something more tangible: a transport corridor linking Central Asia and the South Caucasus with Western markets -- and an investment opportunity for American companies. US Pushes To Turn Armenia-Azerbaijan Transit Deal Into Investment Opportunity.

item.title: Cambodia an early warning of China’s AI surveillance exports
item.description: Chinese investment has long been a cornerstone of development policy for many Southeast Asian nations. From roads and buildings to green energy that helps countries keep up with global environmental regulations, Beijing’s investment has created significant development opportunities. item.title: Five Afghan Family Members Die Of Thirst While Trying To Reach Iran
item.description: An Afghan migrant reported that his stepmother and four sisters died An Afghan migrant has told RFE/RL's Radio Azadi that his stepmother and four sisters died of thirst and hunger while attempting a dangerous journey to Iran after economic hardship forced the family to leave Afghanistan again. Five Afghan Family Members Die Of Thirst While Trying To Reach Iran.

item.title: Delcy Rodríguez poses with Trump in New York as Maduro languishes in jail nearby
item.description: Venezuela’s interim president hails ‘historic meeting’ and does not say whether she will visit snatched predecessorVenezuela’s interim president, Delcy Rodríguez, has celebrated a “historic” meeting with Donald Trump in New York, posing for a smiley photo with the US president, less than nine months after he ordered the abduction of her boss, Nicolás Maduro. Delcy Rodríguez poses with Trump in New York as Maduro languishes in jail nearby.

item.title: Equality ‘ends at the doors of the Security Council’, Kenya’s Ruto tells General Assembly
item.description: Kenyan President William Ruto told the General Assembly on Wednesday that the sovereign equality the UN proclaims is contradicted by its own structures, urging Member States to reform the Security Council and an international financial system “built for another age”. Equality ‘ends at the doors of the Security Council’, Kenya’s Ruto tells General Assembly.

item.title: Rohingya refugees deserve a future beyond survival, not endless displacement
item.description: Nine years after the mass displacement of the Rohingya from Myanmar, their situation remains one of the world's most protracted and complex refugee crises, marked by years of persecution and uncertainty over the prospect of returning home. Rohingya refugees deserve a future beyond survival, not endless displacement.
